elements.requirement: In every trust for sale of land created by a disposition, a power for the trustees to postpone the sale of the land is implied, notwithstanding any contrary provision in the disposition.
elements.quote: In the case of every trust for sale of land created by a disposition there is to be implied, despite any provision to the contrary made by the disposition, a power for the trustees to postpone sale of the land

elements.requirement: Trustees under a trust for sale of land are not liable in any way for postponing the sale of the land for an indefinite period when exercising their discretion.
elements.quote: the trustees are not liable in any way for postponing sale of the land, in the exercise of their discretion, for an indefinite period

elements.requirement: The statutory rules regarding the implied power to postpone sale and relief from liability apply to a trust whether it is created, or arises, before or after the commencement of the Act.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) applies to a trust whether it is created, or arises, before or after the commencement of this Act

elements.requirement: The statutory rules regarding the implied power to postpone sale and relief from liability do not affect any liability incurred by trustees prior to the commencement of the Act.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) does not affect any liability incurred by trustees before that commencement

thresholds.what: the period for which trustees may exercise their discretion to postpone sale of the land without incurring liability
